inquiry: Salaam, we are a family of 5 - two adults and three kids aged 6, 9 and 13. We want to visit Skardu in the summer holidays, first two weeks of August. Nothing too tiring for the little one. About a week. We are from Karachi. Budget around 400 dollars per person.
notes: Children and low fitness should shorten drive days and rule out altitude. Odd group size of 5 also tests room and vehicle arithmetic, which is where a per-person rate quietly goes wrong.
